text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — milestone squeeze: we have a 2-week window to hit the customer pilot. question: what do we absolutely keep in the MVP and what do we push to v1?
Samir (Eng): prioritize the runtime stability and the dedicated routing policy. everything that risks latency SLO should be deferred.
Olivia (Product): agreed. also need the pilot acceptance criteria from the customer — they care most about latency and predictable cost per request.
Maya (PM): customer asked for tenant-level rollout + SSO but said it can be delayed if we have a good canary path.
Dana (Solutions): we can offer a temporary proxy SSO integration for the pilot (short lived) instead of full SAML. low dev cost.
Chris (Eng-Platform): timeline reality: completing SAML + audit logs will add ~3 weeks. we can do partial audit logs (request-level) in 1 week.
Samir (Eng): proposal: MVP = core API surface, routing fallback, canary rollout tooling, prefix cache, basic cost telemetry. Defer: UI onboarding polish, full SAML, long-retention observability.
Olivia (Product): we should sanity-check launch criteria: 99th perc latency < 450ms for 95% of requests, error rate < 0.5%, and pilot acceptance sign-off. Anything not meeting these gets flagged as blocker.
Maya (PM): putting together contingency plan: if SLOs fail in canary, we fallback to smaller batch size + model-variant routing. Is that acceptable to the customer?
Dana (Solutions): yes — customers prefer predictable behavior vs new features. We'll propose explicit fallback in the pilot charter.
Samir (Eng): action: Samir + Chris to build fallback toggle + quick rollout doc (2 days).
Chris (Eng-Platform): added: platform will expose feature-flag for model-variant routing and a health endpoint for canary automation.
Maya (PM): Olivia to update pilot charter and acceptance criteria doc with fallback behavior and deferred items.
Olivia (Product): will do, and will list deferred items with rough ETA for v1 (SAML: +3w, full audit logs: +2w, onboarding UI polish: +4w).
Maya (PM): estimate risk levels on deferred items and owners in the charter.
Samir (Eng): low-risk: UI polish. medium: audit logs. high: SAML. plan to mitigate: proxy SSO + rollout gating.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2027-05-02T14:30Z by @Chris for canary plumbing
Maya (PM): final call: keep MVP tight — core inference + routing + telemetry + canary fallback. everything else moved to v1 or pilot optional features. thumbs? :thumbsup:
Olivia (Product): :thumbsup: locking scope and sending to stakeholders.
Dana (Solutions): will prep customer note explaining what will ship in the pilot and what's planned for v1.
Chris (Eng-Platform): starting work on toggles now, will ping when staging deploy is ready.
Samir (Eng): will pair with Chris on health checks.
Maya (PM): thanks team — I'll post an updated milestone board after the deploy completes.
Olivia (Product): tagging legal for the pilot contract addendum later today.
Maya (PM): closing — we'll reconvene if the canary fails.
